title: The Call Machine's Exit State Is Fixed
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $\mathrm{emit}$ be a Boolean mode, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Every configuration of the call machine on $x$ whose control state is the designated exit state $5$ is fixed by one computation step.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Boolean Turing machine
z is a configuration of the call machine on x
z has control state equal to the designated exit state 5
replaced:
For every mode and every configuration $z$ of the clean-call controller whose control is
the designated exit state, one step of the controller from $z$ equals $z$: the exit
state is silent and absorbing on every tape configuration.
